title: The Brother Is Alive?
summary: Breaching Tartarus, Ha-Jun infiltrates the Spire of Frozen Souls, coming face-to-face with Kang Tae-Jun floating in the cryogenic stasis tube—whose eyes snap open in recognition!

panels.shot: the alien landscape of tartarus: floating obsidian continents
panels.action: A terrifying cosmic abyss: floating islands of black jagged glass drift beneath a void sky rent by green cosmic lightning.
panels.prose_en: A terrifying cosmic abyss: floating islands of black jagged glass drift beneath a void sky rent by green cosmic lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bhayanak brahmandiya khai: kale dantedar kaanch ke tairte dweep, hare brahmandiya bijli dwara kirae par liye gaye shunya aakash ke neeche bahte han.

panels.shot: in the center of the void: the colossal tartarus spire
panels.action: A two-mile-high needle of seamless obsidian and twisted bone rises from a sea of black liquid void energy.
panels.prose_en: A two-mile-high needle of seamless obsidian and twisted bone rises from a sea of black liquid void energy.
panels.prose_hi: Kale taral shunya urja ke samudra se nirbaadh obsidian aur mudi hui haddi ki do meal unchi sui nikalti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and the unified army landing on the spire perimeter bridge
panels.action: Ha-Jun impacts the black bridge in a three-point superhero landing; his army lands in disciplined waves behind him.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun impacts the black bridge in a three-point superhero landing; his army lands in disciplined waves behind him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun teen-bindu superhero landing mein kale pul par prabhav dalta hai; uski sena uske peeche anushasit laharon mein utarti hai.

panels.shot: hundreds of void gargoyles swooping down from spire ramparts
panels.action: Swarming from the gothic spires above, hundreds of winged void gargoyles dive with screeching metal talons.
panels.prose_en: Swarming from the gothic spires above, hundreds of winged void gargoyles dive with screeching metal talons.
panels.prose_hi: Upar gothic minaron se nikalte hue, saikadon pankhon wale shunya gargoil dhatu ke panje ki awaz ke saath gota lagate han.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae opening fire with anti-matter rifles
panels.action: Captain Baek and Min-Jae unleash synchronized anti-matter bursts, blasting three gargoyles out of the sky in purple explosions.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun, go straight for the core! We'll hold the perimeter bridge!

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek and Min-Jae unleash synchronized anti-matter bursts, blasting three gargoyles out of the sky in purple explosions.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake aur min-je ne samkalik anti-mater visfoton ko ujagar kiya, jisse baingani visfoton mein aakash se teen gargoil nasht ho gaye.

panels.shot: iron demon vanguard forming impenetrable shield wall
panels.action: The Iron Demons lock their 8-foot tower shields together, repelling the gargoyle dive-bombers with crushing counter-thrusts.

dialogue.speaker: demon_captain
dialogue.text: FOR THE DEMON SOVEREIGN!! HOLD THE LINE!!

panels.prose_en: The Iron Demons lock their 8-foot tower shields together, repelling the gargoyle dive-bombers with crushing counter-thrusts.
panels.prose_hi: Iron demons ne apne 8-fut tower dhal ko ek saath band kar diya, gargoil gota-bamvarshakon ko kuchalne wale jawabi-jor se khaded diya.

panels.shot: ha-jun blitzing past the frontlines straight into the spire entrance
panels.action: Ha-Jun blurs into Mach 4 speed, a straight line of violet lightning carving through the fortress blast doors.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blurs into Mach 4 speed, a straight line of violet lightning carving through the fortress blast doors.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun mac 4 ki gati mein dhundhla ho jata hai, kile ke blast darvaje ke madhyam se nakkashidar baingani bijli ki ek sidhi rekha.

panels.shot: ha-jun sprinting up endless spiral staircase inside the spire
panels.action: Ha-Jun runs vertically up the inner wall of the hollow spire, gravity bending beneath his boots as he ascends 80 floors.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun runs vertically up the inner wall of the hollow spire, gravity bending beneath his boots as he ascends 80 floors.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun khokhale shikhar ki bhitari deewar par lambvat daudta hai, jab wah 80 manjil chadhta hai to gurutvakarshan uske jooton ke neeche jhuk jata hai.

panels.shot: void priests in ragged black robes casting curses from platforms
panels.action: Robed Void Priests chant ancient hexes, hurling spears of corrosive black acid at his path.
panels.prose_en: Robed Void Priests chant ancient hexes, hurling spears of corrosive black acid at his path.
panels.prose_hi: Labade pahane shunya pujari prachin shatkonon ka jaap karte han, uske raste par sanksharak kale acid ke bhale fenkte han.

panels.shot: kuro slicing through void priests with shadow blade wings
panels.action: Kuro swoops through the platforms like a scythe of midnight, slicing through the priests' staves and silencing their chants.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Keep moving, Ha-Jun! The Chamber of Frozen Souls is right above!

panels.prose_en: Kuro swoops through the platforms like a scythe of midnight, slicing through the priests' staves and silencing their chants.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro aadhi raat ki daranti ki tarah manchon par jhapatta maarta hai, pujariyon ki dandiyon ko kaatata hai aur unke mantron ko shant karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping through the ceiling into chamber level 88
panels.action: Ha-Jun punches straight through the solid obsidian ceiling, emerging into a vast circular chamber of pure zero-degree frost.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun punches straight through the solid obsidian ceiling, emerging into a vast circular chamber of pure zero-degree frost.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun thos obsidian chhat ke madhyam se sidhe mukka maarta hai, shuddh shunya-degri thandh ke ek vishal golakar kaksh mein ubharta hai.

panels.shot: chamber of frozen souls: thousands of glowing cyan stasis pods
panels.action: A breathtaking, chilling sight: thousands of cylindrical glass pods filled with glowing cyan liquid, holding slumbering warriors.
panels.prose_en: A breathtaking, chilling sight: thousands of cylindrical glass pods filled with glowing cyan liquid, holding slumbering warriors.
panels.prose_hi: Ek manmohak, siharan paida kar dene wala drishya: hajaron belanakar kaanch ki phaliyan chamakte siyan taral se bhari hui han, jo neend mein so rahe yoddhaon ko pakad rahi han.

panels.shot: in the elevated center: the primary sovereign stasis pod
panels.action: On a raised dias of interlocking skull carvings stands a massive, reinforced glass pod twice the size of the others.
panels.prose_en: On a raised dias of interlocking skull carvings stands a massive, reinforced glass pod twice the size of the others.
panels.prose_hi: Interlocking khopdi nakkashi ke ek oonche dias par ek vishal, prabalit glass pod khada hai jo anya ke aakaar se doguna hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun slowly walking up the marble steps his breath frosting
panels.action: Ha-Jun ascends the stairs slowly, his heart hammering against his ribs; cold white vapor escapes his parted lips.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Saat saal... Saat saal ka intezaar...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ascends the stairs slowly, his heart hammering against his ribs; cold white vapor escapes his parted lips.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhire-dhire sidhiyan chadhta hai, uska dil uski pasliyon se takra raha hai; uske khule hothon se thandi safed bhaap nikal rahi hai.

panels.shot: seventh void sovereign malakor descending from ceiling shadows
panels.action: From the vaulted ceiling drops the Seventh Void Sovereign 'Malakor'—a 12-foot wraith in bone armor with six burning green eyes.

dialogue.speaker: malakor
dialogue.text: Mortal vermin... You dare trespass in the chamber of the Great Offering?!

panels.prose_en: From the vaulted ceiling drops the Seventh Void Sovereign 'Malakor'—a 12-foot wraith in bone armor with six burning green eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Gumbaddar chhat se saatavi shunya samprabhu 'malakor' girti hai - chhah jalti hui hari aankhon ke saath haddi ke kavach mein 12 foot ka ghera.

panels.shot: malakor swinging massive twin scythes of void decay
panels.action: Malakor swings two colossal scythes dripping with black corrosive energy, aiming to cleave Ha-Jun at the waist.
panels.prose_en: Malakor swings two colossal scythes dripping with black corrosive energy, aiming to cleave Ha-Jun at the waist.
panels.prose_hi: Malakor ne ha-jun ki kamar ko kaatne ke uddeshya se kali sanksharak urja se bhari do vishal hansiya ghumai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching both scythe blades with bare hands using ring of hollow blood
panels.action: Using the Ring of Hollow Blood to harden his skin to adamantine, Ha-Jun catches both lethal scythe blades in his bare palms.
panels.prose_en: Using the Ring of Hollow Blood to harden his skin to adamantine, Ha-Jun catches both lethal scythe blades in his bare palms.
panels.prose_hi: Apni tvacha ko sakht karne ke liye khokhale khoon ki anguthi ka upyog karte hue, ha-jun apni nangi hatheliyon mein donon ghatak skith blade pakadta hai.

panels.shot: malakor six eyes widening in absolute terror
panels.action: The Void Sovereign's eyes bug out in horror: 'Caught my Void Scythes with bare flesh?! What kind of abomination are you?!'

dialogue.speaker: malakor
dialogue.text: Impossible! Even Void Kings bleed from my touch!

panels.prose_en: The Void Sovereign's eyes bug out in horror: 'Caught my Void Scythes with bare flesh?! What kind of abomination are you?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Shunya samprabhu ki aankhen bhay se bahar aa gain: 'mere shunya skiths ko nange maans ke saath pakad liya?! tum kis prakar ke ghrinit ho?!'

panels.shot: ha-jun shattering both scythes with crushing grip
panels.action: Ha-Jun wrenches his wrists; the ancient void scythes shatter into thousands of black iron fragments.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wrenches his wrists; the ancient void scythes shatter into thousands of black iron fragments.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni kalaiyan bhinchta hai; prachin shunya daranti hazaron kale lohe ke tukdon mein bikhar jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving sanguine fang straight through malakor heart core
panels.action: In the same breath, Ha-Jun thrusts his blood katana through Malakor's chest core, pinning the demon god to the pedestal.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum mere aur mere bhai ke darmiyan khade hone ke laayak nahi ho.

panels.prose_en: In the same breath, Ha-Jun thrusts his blood katana through Malakor's chest core, pinning the demon god to the pedestal.
panels.prose_hi: Usi saans men, ha-jun ne malakor ki chhati ke core ke madhyam se apna rakt katana dala, aur danav devta ko aasan par gira diya.

panels.shot: malakor disintegrating into grey ash with a dying shriek
panels.action: Malakor shrieks as golden sovereign fire consumes him from inside, crumbling his 12-foot frame into harmless grey ash.
panels.prose_en: Malakor shrieks as golden sovereign fire consumes him from inside, crumbling his 12-foot frame into harmless grey ash.
panels.prose_hi: Malakor chillata hai kyonki sunhari samprabhu aag use andar se bhasm kar deti hai, jisse uska 12 foot ka shareer hanirahit bhure rang ki raakh mein badal jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing before the giant glass stasis pod undisturbed
panels.action: The ash settles; Ha-Jun stands directly in front of the giant glass tube, wiping a single drop of sweat from his brow.
panels.prose_en: The ash settles; Ha-Jun stands directly in front of the giant glass tube, wiping a single drop of sweat from his brow.
panels.prose_hi: Rakh jam jaati hai; ha-jun apne mathe se pasine ki ek boond ponchte hue sidhe vishal kaanch ki tube ke samne khada hai.

panels.shot: glowing cyan liquid inside pod revealing floating young man
panels.action: Inside the bubbling fluorescent cyan fluid floats a 22-year-old young man with jet-black hair and a chiseled jawline.
panels.prose_en: Inside the bubbling fluorescent cyan fluid floats a 22-year-old young man with jet-black hair and a chiseled jawline.
panels.prose_hi: Budbudate fluorescent siyan taral padarth ke andar jet-kale baalon aur tarashi hui jabde wala ek 22 varshiya yuvak tair raha hai.

panels.shot: extreme close-up on floating young man: kang tae-jun
panels.action: His eyes are closed peacefully; twin small obsidian demonic horns curve back gracefully from his temples.

dialogue.text: Kang Tae-Jun. The elder brother. Alive.

panels.prose_en: His eyes are closed peacefully; twin small obsidian demonic horns curve back gracefully from his temples.
panels.prose_hi: Uski aankhen shanti se band han; judwan chhote obsidian rakshasi seeng uske mandiron se sundar dhang se peeche ki or mude hue han.

panels.shot: ha-jun placing his trembling palm against the cold glass
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his warm right hand against the frozen glass, right opposite Tae-Jun's floating face.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung... Main aa gaya. I promised you I'd find you.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his warm right hand against the frozen glass, right opposite Tae-Jun's floating face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne garm dahine haath ko taaye-jun ke tairte chehre ke theek samne, jame hue kaanch par dabata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sovereign mana radiating through the glass
panels.action: A soft, radiant pulse of royal violet mana flows from Ha-Jun's fingertips, warming the freezing fluid inside.
panels.prose_en: A soft, radiant pulse of royal violet mana flows from Ha-Jun's fingertips, warming the freezing fluid inside.
panels.prose_hi: Roil violet man ki ek naram, ujjwal naadi ha-jun ki ungaliyon se bahti hai, jo andar jame hue taral padarth ko garm karti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun chest inside the tube rising with a sudden deep breath
panels.action: Tae-Jun's chest expands; bubbles rush from his lips as his suspended lungs reactivate.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's chest expands; bubbles rush from his lips as his suspended lungs reactivate.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki chhati chaudi ho gai; jaise hi uske latke hue fefde punah sakriya hote han, uske hothon se bulbule nikalte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun eyelids trembling and slowly snapping open
panels.action: Tae-Jun's eyes snap wide open—revealing irises glowing with the exact same radiant royal violet light as Ha-Jun!
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's eyes snap wide open—revealing irises glowing with the exact same radiant royal violet light as Ha-Jun!.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki aankhen puri tarah se khul gai - ha-jun ki tarah hi chamakdar shahi baingani roshni ke saath chamakti hui putliyan!

panels.shot: tae-jun hand slowly lifting through the fluid touching ha-jun hand
panels.action: From inside the fluid, Tae-Jun lifts his pale hand, pressing his palm against the glass directly matching Ha-Jun's palm.
panels.prose_en: From inside the fluid, Tae-Jun lifts his pale hand, pressing his palm against the glass directly matching Ha-Jun's palm.
panels.prose_hi: Taral padarth ke andar se, taaye-jun apna peela haath uthata hai, aur apni hatheli ko sidhe ha-jun ki hatheli se mail khate gilas par dabata hai.

panels.shot: spiderweb cracks spreading across the glass as arc 7 concludes
panels.action: Spiderweb cracks of blinding golden light shoot across the glass tube, about to burst as the brothers reunite!

dialogue.text: ARC 7: THE BROTHER'S TRUTH — CONCLUDED. NEXT: ARC 8 — THE MYTHIC AWAKENING.

panels.prose_en: Spiderweb cracks of blinding golden light shoot across the glass tube, about to burst as the brothers reunite!.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ki nali par chakachaundh kar dene wali sunhari roshni ki makdi ke jale ki dararen pad jaati han, jo bhaiyon ke punarmilan ke saath hi phutne wali hoti han!
